name: world-open
js: const h=document.querySelector('[data-map-sheet]');if(h.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true')h.click(); const b=document.querySelector('[data-map-layer=world]');if(!b.getBoundingClientRect().width)throw new Error('World entry not visible');b.click()

name: kenya-gate
js: (()=>{const goButtons=document.querySelectorAll('.wm [data-wm-go]').length,countyCount=document.querySelectorAll('[data-wm-region] option').length;if(goButtons!==0||countyCount!==48)throw new Error('Kenya access/count contract failed');return {goButtons,counties:countyCount-1};})()

name: world-drag-proof
js: (()=>{const count=Number(document.querySelector('.wm-model-stage').dataset.renderCount);if(count<2)throw new Error('Map drag did not reach the canvas');return {renderCount:count};})()

name: world-idle
js: (async()=>{const n=document.querySelector('.wm-model-stage');const before=n.dataset.renderCount;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200));if(before!==n.dataset.renderCount)throw new Error('World rendered while idle');return {before,after:n.dataset.renderCount}})()

name: destination
js: const pin=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-label')?.startsWith('Market,')&&b.getBoundingClientRect().width);if(!pin)throw new Error('Market marker not visible');pin.click()

name: arrival
js: (async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,18000));const state=await fetch('/api/life?city=lagos').then(r=>r.json()).then(x=>x.state);if(state.location!=='market'||state.activeAction)throw new Error('Trip did not settle');return {location:state.location,active:state.activeAction,cash:state.cash};})()
